items_flat.title_en: Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX AI to halt frontier development
items_flat.title_zh: 非營利組織起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI，要求停止前沿發展
items_flat.summary_en: Four nonprofits including Public Citizen and the Irreplaceable Education Fund filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court on November 12 against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX’s AI division. They seek a court order under California’s Unfair Competition Law to block further development or deployment of models more capable than current flagships, citing public nuisance risks from cyberattacks, bioweapons and loss of control, and referencing labs’ own warnings.
items_flat.summary_zh: 包括Public Citizen與Irreplaceable Education Fund在內的四個非營利組織於11月12日在舊金山高等法院起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI部門。他們依加州不公平競爭法尋求法院命令，禁止開發或部署比現有旗艦更強大的模型，並以網路攻擊、生物武器與失控風險構成公共滋擾為由，同時引用各實驗室自身警告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The suit tests whether state consumer-protection statutes can impose a de-facto pause on frontier training across multiple labs at once. No injunction has been granted, and the outcome will hinge on how courts weigh the labs’ risk acknowledgments against claims of imminent public harm.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此訴訟測試州級消費者保護法規能否同時對多家實驗室施加實質暫停前沿訓練。目前尚未核發禁令，結果將取決於法院如何權衡實驗室自身風險承認與迫在眉睫公共危害的主張。
items_flat.quote: We must freeze frontier AI development until the technology is under control and the American people have a say and a stake in its future.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們必須凍結前沿AI發展，直到技術受控，且美國人民對其未來擁有發言權與利益。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA board announces Jensen Huang resignation; Colette Kress named interim CEO
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳辭職；Colette Kress暫代CEO
items_flat.summary_en: On November 12 NVIDIA’s board announced that Jensen Huang resigned immediately as President, CEO and director. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while retaining her finance role; the board is searching for a permanent successor. Subsequent reporting detailed prior internal friction, including Huang describing Kress as a “deer in the headlights” during summer discussions of large chip guarantees and supply commitments.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳立即辭去總裁、CEO與董事職務。CFO Colette Kress被任命為暫代CEO並繼續兼任財務職務；董事會正尋找永久繼任者。後續報導詳述先前內部摩擦，包括黃仁勳在夏季討論大型晶片擔保與供應承諾時形容Kress為「一頭傻眼的鹿」。
items_flat.analysis_en: The sudden leadership change at the company whose GPUs power most frontier training introduces near-term operational continuity risk and longer-term uncertainty about product and partnership priorities. Internal commentary already suggests differing views on deal-making intensity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 作為供應大多數前沿訓練GPU的公司突然更換領導，帶來短期營運連續性風險與長期產品及夥伴優先順序的不確定性。內部評論已顯示對交易積極程度的不同看法。
items_flat.quote: Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position.
items_flat.quote_zh: Colette協助帶領NVIDIA度過非凡成長時期，對我們的業務、客戶、營運與財務狀況有深刻了解。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agentic payments via Dots
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT錢包，供Dots代理進行支付
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, a payment method that lets Dots agents complete purchases without seeing users’ actual card details. Users add a card once, review each order, and approve via biometric check; the network issues a substitute credential. It is rolling out gradually to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers age 18+ with eligible US-issued cards, in partnership with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月13日宣布ChatGPT錢包，讓Dots代理在不看到使用者實際卡片細節的情況下完成購買。使用者新增卡片一次，檢視每筆訂單後以生物辨識核准；網路會發行替代憑證。它正逐步向18歲以上美國ChatGPT Pro訂閱者開放，合作夥伴包括美國運通、萬事達與Visa。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agentic commerce from research to a production payment rail with major networks, but early geographic and plan limits plus potential merchant blocks mean real-world volume will depend on completion rates and user trust in the review-and-approve flow.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理商務從研究推向與主要網路合作的生產支付軌道，但早期地理與方案限制加上可能的商家封鎖，意味真實交易量將取決於完成率與使用者對檢視核准流程的信任。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT Wallet helps your dot go from finding what you need to making a purchase on your behalf.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT錢包幫助你的dot從找到你需要的東西，到代表你完成購買。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory AI security tools
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Daybreak Red Team與Defense Factory AI安全工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory as part of its Daybreak platform at the Cyber at the Frontier event. Red Team uses AI agents in isolated environments to test web applications for exploitable vulnerabilities under Guardian review; Defense Factory, powered by GPT-6 Cyber, investigates findings and proposes code patches. Early access is available by request.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI在Cyber at the Frontier活動宣布Daybreak Red Team與Daybreak Defense Factory作為Daybreak平台的一部分。Red Team使用AI代理在隔離環境中測試網頁應用程式的可利用漏洞，並受Guardian審查；Defense Factory由GPT-6 Cyber驅動，調查發現並提出程式碼修補。目前接受早期存取申請。
items_flat.analysis_en: The tools shift OpenAI further into defensive cybersecurity by automating both discovery and patching, reflecting the lab’s view that the bottleneck has moved from finding flaws to fixing them at scale. Real impact depends on adoption by enterprise security teams and false-positive rates.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些工具讓OpenAI進一步進入防禦性網路安全，自動化發現與修補，反映實驗室認為瓶頸已從找出漏洞轉向大規模修復。實際影響取決於企業安全團隊採用率與誤報率。
items_flat.quote: Agents use source code and app context to investigate attack paths and confirm vulnerabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 代理使用原始碼與應用程式上下文調查攻擊路徑並確認漏洞。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings beta for Google Meet
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings Google Meet測試版
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise plans. Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant, takes notes, answers questions in chat, and drafts documents, whiteboards or other artifacts in real time. It leaves automatically if external guests join unless authorized; generated materials are available afterward in claude.ai and are free through February 10, 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic為Team與Enterprise方案推出Claude Meetings測試版。Claude以可見參與者身份加入Google Meet通話，記錄筆記、在聊天中回答問題，並即時起草文件、白板或其他產物。若有外部訪客加入且未經授權會自動離開；產出材料事後可在claude.ai取得，並免費至2027年2月10日。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature moves AI from post-meeting summarization to live collaboration inside the call, which could compress the time from discussion to actionable output. Privacy defaults (auto-leave on external guests) address a clear enterprise concern while the free period lowers the barrier to testing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能將AI從會後摘要推進到通話中的即時協作，可能壓縮從討論到可執行產出的時間。外部訪客自動離開的隱私預設解決明確企業顧慮，而免費期間降低測試門檻。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude現在可以以可見參與者身份加入你的視訊通話，跟隨對話並在會議期間開始工作。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind發布PARDIG與SatWeave天氣資料集
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind open-sourced PARDIG and SatWeave, the foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3. PARDIG provides AI-estimated global precipitation every 15 minutes at roughly 10 km resolution with improved detection skill; SatWeave combines geostationary satellite imagery into a unified hourly view of clouds and storms. The data are available on Google Cloud Storage and Earth Engine.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind開源PARDIG與SatWeave，這是WeatherNext 3背後的基礎資料集。PARDIG提供每15分鐘約10公里解析度的AI估計全球降水，並提升偵測技能；SatWeave將多顆地球靜止衛星影像整合成雲層與風暴的每小時統一視圖。資料可在Google Cloud Storage與Earth Engine取得。
items_flat.analysis_en: Releasing the observation datasets rather than only the forecasting model lowers the barrier for external researchers to improve or audit weather AI. Claims of more than 30% better light-to-moderate precipitation detection remain Google’s own and will need independent verification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 發布觀測資料集而非僅預測模型，降低外部研究者改進或審核天氣AI的門檻。超過30%更好的輕至中度降水偵測主張仍是Google自身數據，需要獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: These datasets make it easier for teams to tackle real-world problems - from being able to issue more accurate flood warnings in regions without ground radar to tracking wildfire smoke and solar energy.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些資料集讓團隊更容易解決真實世界問題——從在沒有地面雷達的地區發出更準確的洪水警告，到追蹤野火煙霧與太陽能。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI disbands standalone robotics team, folds staff into general research and applied orgs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI解散獨立機器人團隊，將人員併入通用研究與應用部門
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI confirmed to Fortune on November 13 that it has disbanded its standalone robotics team. Research staff moved under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen; applied robotics and hardware teams moved under President Greg Brockman. The company said general models such as GPT-6 Astra can now be applied directly to robots and that the change accelerates rather than abandons robotics work; a public humanoid demo remains targeted for 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月13日向Fortune確認已解散獨立機器人團隊。研究人員轉至首席研究官Mark Chen麾下；應用機器人與硬體團隊轉至總裁Greg Brockman的應用部門。公司表示包括GPT-6 Astra在內的通用模型已能直接應用於機器人，此調整是加速而非放棄機器人工作；公開人形機器人展示仍目標2027年。
items_flat.analysis_en: The second dissolution of a dedicated robotics group in six years signals greater confidence that frontier language models can substitute for specialized robotics stacks on certain tasks, though real-world hardware integration, latency and cost remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 六年內第二次解散專責機器人團隊，顯示對前沿語言模型能在特定任務上取代專門機器人堆疊的信心增加，但真實世界硬體整合、延遲與成本仍是未決問題。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI remains committed to bringing general-purpose robots into the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI仍致力於將通用機器人帶入世界。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens private beta for self-hosted Claude Managed Agents
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開放自託管Claude Managed Agents私人測試版
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 12 a private beta of self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Customers can now run the full service—including the server, PostgreSQL database for agents and session history, sandboxes, credentials and workers—on their own cloud or on-premises infrastructure. Model requests still go to Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Google Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry or a customer gateway; some hosted features such as webhooks and scheduled runs are not yet available.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月12日宣布自託管Claude Managed Agents私人測試版。客戶現在可在自有雲端或本地基礎設施上運行完整服務，包括伺服器、存放代理與會話歷史的PostgreSQL資料庫、沙箱、憑證與工作者。模型請求仍送至Anthropic、Amazon Bedrock、Google Agent Platform、Microsoft Foundry或客戶閘道；部分託管功能如webhooks與排程執行尚未提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Full self-hosting of the agent control plane addresses data-residency and credential concerns that previously limited enterprise adoption, yet the model itself remains external and the license includes short safety-response windows. Adoption will depend on operational overhead versus the security gains.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 完整自託管代理控制平面解決先前限制企業採用的資料駐留與憑證顧慮，但模型本身仍在外部，且授權包含短安全回應窗口。採用將取決於營運負擔與安全增益的權衡。
items_flat.quote: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents is now available in private beta. Developers can build agents that work directly in their company's code and internal systems, and run those agents in their own environment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自託管Claude Managed Agents現已提供私人測試版。開發者可建立直接在公司程式碼與內部系統工作的代理，並在自有環境中運行這些代理。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes recommendations for building strong AI safety evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic發布建立強大AI安全評估的建議
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13 Anthropic posted an Engineering Blog piece outlining ten recommendations for designing, running and reporting safety evaluations. It emphasizes multi-turn appropriate-response rates over simple refusal, domain-expert rubrics, and careful documentation of setup differences that can dramatically change headline scores.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日Anthropic在Engineering Blog發表文章，列出設計、執行與報告安全評估的十項建議。它強調多輪適當回應率優於單純拒絕、領域專家評分標準，以及仔細記錄可能大幅改變頭條分數的設定差異。
items_flat.analysis_en: By documenting how headline safety scores can shift dramatically with setup (e.g., API vs. product system prompt), the post increases transparency but also underscores that published numbers are highly sensitive to evaluation design choices.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過記錄頭條安全分數如何因設定（例如API與產品系統提示）而大幅變動，此文增加透明度，同時也凸顯已發布數字對評估設計選擇高度敏感。
items_flat.quote: Safety evaluations are critical for understanding whether a model is ready to deploy, which safeguards to build for it, and where to focus training and research.
items_flat.quote_zh: 安全評估對於了解模型是否準備好部署、應為其建立哪些防護措施，以及訓練與研究應聚焦何處至關重要。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Grok Bot can now join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls
items_flat.title_zh: xAI Grok Bot現可加入Google Meet、Zoom與Teams通話
items_flat.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot announced on November 13 that it can join video meetings. Users paste a Meet, Zoom or Teams link and approve; the bot appears as a named participant, takes notes, answers in chat, and delivers a summary plus action items afterward. Admission still requires user approval and certain plan tiers for full team features.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI的Grok Bot於11月13日宣布可加入視訊會議。使用者貼上Meet、Zoom或Teams連結並核准；機器人會以具名參與者身份出現，記錄筆記、在聊天中回答，並事後交付摘要與行動項目。加入仍需使用者核准，完整團隊功能則需要特定方案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Meeting attendance expands Grok Bot from asynchronous chat into real-time workplace context, paralleling similar features from Anthropic and others, though admission still requires explicit user approval and plan restrictions limit broad availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 會議參與將Grok Bot從非同步聊天擴展到即時職場情境，與Anthropic等類似功能平行，但加入仍需明確使用者核准，且方案限制限制廣泛可用性。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot can now join meetings. Ask it questions, assign it work, or have it keep track of what your team decides.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現在可以加入會議。向它提問、指派工作，或讓它追蹤團隊決定的事項。

anthropic.analysis_en: The feature moves AI from post-meeting summarization to live collaboration inside the call, which could compress the time from discussion to actionable output. Privacy defaults (auto-leave on external guests) address a clear enterprise concern while the free period lowers the barrier to testing.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此功能將AI從會後摘要推進到通話中的即時協作，可能壓縮從討論到可執行產出的時間。外部訪客自動離開的隱私預設解決明確企業顧慮，而免費期間降低測試門檻。
anthropic.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude現在可以以可見參與者身份加入你的視訊通話，跟隨對話並在會議期間開始工作。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens private beta for self-hosted Claude Managed Agents
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開放自託管Claude Managed Agents私人測試版
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 12 a private beta of self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Customers can now run the full service—including the server, PostgreSQL database for agents and session history, sandboxes, credentials and workers—on their own cloud or on-premises infrastructure. Model requests still go to Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Google Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry or a customer gateway; some hosted features such as webhooks and scheduled runs are not yet available.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月12日宣布自託管Claude Managed Agents私人測試版。客戶現在可在自有雲端或本地基礎設施上運行完整服務，包括伺服器、存放代理與會話歷史的PostgreSQL資料庫、沙箱、憑證與工作者。模型請求仍送至Anthropic、Amazon Bedrock、Google Agent Platform、Microsoft Foundry或客戶閘道；部分託管功能如webhooks與排程執行尚未提供。
anthropic.analysis_en: Full self-hosting of the agent control plane addresses data-residency and credential concerns that previously limited enterprise adoption, yet the model itself remains external and the license includes short safety-response windows. Adoption will depend on operational overhead versus the security gains.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 完整自託管代理控制平面解決先前限制企業採用的資料駐留與憑證顧慮，但模型本身仍在外部，且授權包含短安全回應窗口。採用將取決於營運負擔與安全增益的權衡。
anthropic.quote: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents is now available in private beta. Developers can build agents that work directly in their company's code and internal systems, and run those agents in their own environment.
anthropic.quote_zh: 自託管Claude Managed Agents現已提供私人測試版。開發者可建立直接在公司程式碼與內部系統工作的代理，並在自有環境中運行這些代理。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic publishes recommendations for building strong AI safety evaluations
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic發布建立強大AI安全評估的建議
anthropic.summary_en: On November 13 Anthropic posted an Engineering Blog piece outlining ten recommendations for designing, running and reporting safety evaluations. It emphasizes multi-turn appropriate-response rates over simple refusal, domain-expert rubrics, and careful documentation of setup differences that can dramatically change headline scores.
anthropic.summary_zh: 11月13日Anthropic在Engineering Blog發表文章，列出設計、執行與報告安全評估的十項建議。它強調多輪適當回應率優於單純拒絕、領域專家評分標準，以及仔細記錄可能大幅改變頭條分數的設定差異。
anthropic.analysis_en: By documenting how headline safety scores can shift dramatically with setup (e.g., API vs. product system prompt), the post increases transparency but also underscores that published numbers are highly sensitive to evaluation design choices.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 透過記錄頭條安全分數如何因設定（例如API與產品系統提示）而大幅變動，此文增加透明度，同時也凸顯已發布數字對評估設計選擇高度敏感。
anthropic.quote: Safety evaluations are critical for understanding whether a model is ready to deploy, which safeguards to build for it, and where to focus training and research.
anthropic.quote_zh: 安全評估對於了解模型是否準備好部署、應為其建立哪些防護措施，以及訓練與研究應聚焦何處至關重要。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind發布PARDIG與SatWeave天氣資料集
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind open-sourced PARDIG and SatWeave, the foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3. PARDIG provides AI-estimated global precipitation every 15 minutes at roughly 10 km resolution with improved detection skill; SatWeave combines geostationary satellite imagery into a unified hourly view of clouds and storms. The data are available on Google Cloud Storage and Earth Engine.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind開源PARDIG與SatWeave，這是WeatherNext 3背後的基礎資料集。PARDIG提供每15分鐘約10公里解析度的AI估計全球降水，並提升偵測技能；SatWeave將多顆地球靜止衛星影像整合成雲層與風暴的每小時統一視圖。資料可在Google Cloud Storage與Earth Engine取得。
google.analysis_en: Releasing the observation datasets rather than only the forecasting model lowers the barrier for external researchers to improve or audit weather AI. Claims of more than 30% better light-to-moderate precipitation detection remain Google’s own and will need independent verification.
google.analysis_zh: 發布觀測資料集而非僅預測模型，降低外部研究者改進或審核天氣AI的門檻。超過30%更好的輕至中度降水偵測主張仍是Google自身數據，需要獨立驗證。
google.quote: These datasets make it easier for teams to tackle real-world problems - from being able to issue more accurate flood warnings in regions without ground radar to tracking wildfire smoke and solar energy.
google.quote_zh: 這些資料集讓團隊更容易解決真實世界問題——從在沒有地面雷達的地區發出更準確的洪水警告，到追蹤野火煙霧與太陽能。

xai.title_en: xAI Grok Bot can now join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls
xai.title_zh: xAI Grok Bot現可加入Google Meet、Zoom與Teams通話
xai.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot announced on November 13 that it can join video meetings. Users paste a Meet, Zoom or Teams link and approve; the bot appears as a named participant, takes notes, answers in chat, and delivers a summary plus action items afterward. Admission still requires user approval and certain plan tiers for full team features.
xai.summary_zh: xAI的Grok Bot於11月13日宣布可加入視訊會議。使用者貼上Meet、Zoom或Teams連結並核准；機器人會以具名參與者身份出現，記錄筆記、在聊天中回答，並事後交付摘要與行動項目。加入仍需使用者核准，完整團隊功能則需要特定方案。
xai.analysis_en: Meeting attendance expands Grok Bot from asynchronous chat into real-time workplace context, paralleling similar features from Anthropic and others, though admission still requires explicit user approval and plan restrictions limit broad availability.
xai.analysis_zh: 會議參與將Grok Bot從非同步聊天擴展到即時職場情境，與Anthropic等類似功能平行，但加入仍需明確使用者核准，且方案限制限制廣泛可用性。
xai.quote: Grok Bot can now join meetings. Ask it questions, assign it work, or have it keep track of what your team decides.
xai.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現在可以加入會議。向它提問、指派工作，或讓它追蹤團隊決定的事項。

frontier_other.title_en: Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX AI to halt frontier development
frontier_other.title_zh: 非營利組織起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI，要求停止前沿發展
frontier_other.summary_en: Four nonprofits including Public Citizen and the Irreplaceable Education Fund filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court on November 12 against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX’s AI division. They seek a court order under California’s Unfair Competition Law to block further development or deployment of models more capable than current flagships, citing public nuisance risks from cyberattacks, bioweapons and loss of control, and referencing labs’ own warnings.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 包括Public Citizen與Irreplaceable Education Fund在內的四個非營利組織於11月12日在舊金山高等法院起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI部門。他們依加州不公平競爭法尋求法院命令，禁止開發或部署比現有旗艦更強大的模型，並以網路攻擊、生物武器與失控風險構成公共滋擾為由，同時引用各實驗室自身警告。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The suit tests whether state consumer-protection statutes can impose a de-facto pause on frontier training across multiple labs at once. No injunction has been granted, and the outcome will hinge on how courts weigh the labs’ risk acknowledgments against claims of imminent public harm.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此訴訟測試州級消費者保護法規能否同時對多家實驗室施加實質暫停前沿訓練。目前尚未核發禁令，結果將取決於法院如何權衡實驗室自身風險承認與迫在眉睫公共危害的主張。
frontier_other.quote: We must freeze frontier AI development until the technology is under control and the American people have a say and a stake in its future.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們必須凍結前沿AI發展，直到技術受控，且美國人民對其未來擁有發言權與利益。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA board announces Jensen Huang resignation; Colette Kress named interim CEO
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳辭職；Colette Kress暫代CEO
frontier_other.summary_en: On November 12 NVIDIA’s board announced that Jensen Huang resigned immediately as President, CEO and director. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while retaining her finance role; the board is searching for a permanent successor. Subsequent reporting detailed prior internal friction, including Huang describing Kress as a “deer in the headlights” during summer discussions of large chip guarantees and supply commitments.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 11月12日NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳立即辭去總裁、CEO與董事職務。CFO Colette Kress被任命為暫代CEO並繼續兼任財務職務；董事會正尋找永久繼任者。後續報導詳述先前內部摩擦，包括黃仁勳在夏季討論大型晶片擔保與供應承諾時形容Kress為「一頭傻眼的鹿」。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The sudden leadership change at the company whose GPUs power most frontier training introduces near-term operational continuity risk and longer-term uncertainty about product and partnership priorities. Internal commentary already suggests differing views on deal-making intensity.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 作為供應大多數前沿訓練GPU的公司突然更換領導，帶來短期營運連續性風險與長期產品及夥伴優先順序的不確定性。內部評論已顯示對交易積極程度的不同看法。
frontier_other.quote: Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Colette協助帶領NVIDIA度過非凡成長時期，對我們的業務、客戶、營運與財務狀況有深刻了解。

brief_en: Nonprofits sued major labs to freeze frontier AI; NVIDIA's Jensen Huang resigned with Colette Kress interim CEO. OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Wallet for agent payments, Daybreak security tools, and folded its robotics team into general models. Anthropic betaed Claude Meetings and self-hosted Managed Agents; Google released weather datasets; xAI expanded Grok Bot to meetings.
brief_zh: 非營利組織起訴要求凍結前沿AI；NVIDIA黃仁勳辭職、Colette Kress暫代CEO。OpenAI推出ChatGPT錢包與Daybreak安全工具，並將機器人團隊併入通用模型。Anthropic上線Claude Meetings與自託管Managed Agents測試；Google開放天氣資料集；xAI讓Grok Bot加入會議。
